authority: the pool's last usable Fly machines list (BH-9407)
note:
state/fly-pool-listing/

.json: the last `flyctl machines list` answer that was a usable array, minus every machine a destroy removed since, written tmp+mv by pool_list_save_good (config/fly-pool.d/3350-bh-9407-listing-retry.sh) after each sweep. Its mtime is the time Fly gave that answer. Read by pool_list_saved_pick only when every try of a tick's listing failed, and only while it is younger than the fly-pool knob POOL_LIST_SAVED_MAX_AGE_S (default 600 s); it then drives a destroy-only sweep (no requeue, no observe, no orphan pass). One overwritten file per project. Losing it costs one dark sweep tick (the alert that existed before BH-9407). Machine-local, NOT CARRIED
